The zirconium boride and titanium boride powders can be used as ultra high temperature wear and oxidation resistant component, therrmocouple sleeves, nuclear components (boron capture), sputtering targets, evaporation boats, electride for Al-extraction (Hall- heraoult), hypersonic aero-engine components, rocket nozzles, dome for re-entry vehicle, etc. Production of zirconium boride and titanium boride powder in single step process is difficult. The process requires low cost raw materials and therefore economical and easy to sacle up. The average particle size is 10um. The purity of the material is more than 95%.
sector: Coatings [ Metallurgy ]; Synhtesis Procesess [ Drugs and Pharmaceuticals ]

title: Zn-Ni-Cu Coatings for Anti-bacterial and Fuel Tank Applications
summary: Zn-Ni-Cu Coatings using thermal spary tecnique Coated steel for antibacterial resistance in Acs, refrigerators, windows, air coolers, automobile fuel tank, etc. Improved corrosion resistances in foul fuel media as well as microbial attack. Antibacterial characteristics of the coated steel by killing the microbes. The coatings do not require hexavalent chrome passivation. It is easy to scale up. No significant environmental issues in the process or coatings.
sector: Coatings [ Metallurgy ]

title: Agrotechnology for cultivation of Tinospora cordifolia (Thunb.) Miers [RRL(J)-82], Giloye, Guduchi in varying climatic condition.
summary: Cultivation of Tinospora cordifolia (Thunb.) Miers [RRL(J)-82] medicinal plant Large scale cultivation of Tinospora cordifolia (Thunb.) Miers [RRL(J)-82] medicianl plant. For uses in pharmaceutical industries.
sector: Medicinal and Aromatics Plants [ Agriculture ]

title: Beneficiation of Low-grade Tungsten Ores
summary: The technology to produce Tungsten involving beneficiation and hydrometallurgical extraction from wolframite concentrate. The technique involves beneficiation of low- and lean-grade ores along with hydrometallurgical extraction of tungsten, in which the concentration of the lean ore is achieved basically by gravity and magnetic separation techniques followed by, hydrometallurgical extraction of tungsten from wolframite concentrate to obtain ammonium para-tungstate. The tungsten produced finds its application in defence, space and other industrial application. The process is environment friendly.
sector: Mineral Separation [ Mining and Minerals ]

title: Clean Coal from Coking/Non-coking Coal/Coal Slurry
summary: Production of clean coal ( 12-17%) from raw coals of cooking/non-coking or coal slurry. The technology involves flotation of raw coals of coking/non- coking, or coal slurry of the washing circuit to produce a clean coal of 12-17% ash from a feed of 22-30% ash. The application involves the metallurgical use for coking, for direct reduction of iron ore, coaldust injuction in blast furnace. Comparitively more production of clean coal of 12-17% ash from a feed of 22-30% ash.
sector: Mining Techniques/Processes [ Mining and Minerals ]

title: Electronic weighing based Fruit Sorting System
summary: Singulated fruits moving on a cup conveyor system are weighed dynamically using a specially mounted load cell and sorted into different grades according to user specified weight ranges. The system sorts fruits into several categories based on their weights measured using an electronic weighing arrangement. Useful for sorting of fruits like mangoes, citrus, etc. Useful for the fruit processing industry, especially in packing of fruits. NA
sector: Instrumentation, Appliances, Devices Applications [ Instrumentation, Appliances, Devices ]; Measurement [ Instrumentation, Appliances, Devices ]

title: Ferrosilicon from BHQ, BHJ & Low Reactive Coal
summary: Preparation of Ferrosilicon from non standard material such as BHQ, BHJ & Low Reactive Coal Ferosilicon can be used as an 1. alloying element, 2. deoxydiser in iron and steel industry 3.electrode coating in arc welding 4. in production of magnesium, as reductant in pidgon process. Use of non-standard materials such as BHQ, BHJ & Jhama coal for production of Standard Ferro-silicon which is more suitable for iron and steel sector.
sector: Alloys [ Metallurgy ]; Metal Recyling [ Metallurgy ]

title: Hybrid Wood Substitute Composite
summary: The composites developed is a substitute for timber and plastic products. This technology has been developed as a consequence of the National Forest industry. Door, false ceiling, flooring, roofing, partition, and furniture. Building construction industries, automobile, locomotive and transport system Stronger ( flexural, impact strength) than wood Weather resistant and durable Termite fungus, rot and rodent, moisture, resistant Fire retardant, self-extinguishing nature More cost effective than teak wood, GRP and products Maintenance free
sector: Composites [ Materials ]

title: Phosphate Concentrate
summary: Process for production of Phosphate by froth flotation technique. It involves separation of phosphate containing minerals from low-grade ore by froth flotation technique. The product is suitable for its application in manufacture of phosphoric acid and phosphatic fertilizers. The process is environmental friendly.
sector: Mineral Separation [ Mining and Minerals ]

title: Separation of Quartz & Feldspar
summary: Recovery and separation of quartz and feldspar by froth flotation technique. The technology is based on recovery of minerals by froth flotation. The separation of quartz and feldspar from the ground ore-slurry is achieved by differential flotation using a suitable reagent scheme. The product formed founds its application in glass and ceramic industry. The further scale-up more than 10 kg is possible.
sector: Mineral Separation [ Mining and Minerals ]

title: Sintering of Iron Ore with High Percentage of Micro-fines.
summary: Production of iron ore sinter through micro-pelletisation cum sintering process. The technology is based on the process to produces iron ore sinter for iron and steel making. Iron ore containing high amount of micro-fines can be utilized for iron making through micro-pelletisation cum sintering without curing. The Induration process is eliminated through Micro-pelletisation cum sintering.
sector: Making Processes [ Metallurgy ]
